title: vtc and chat: tests for server-set/immutable fields
description: From audits JMAP-t8ej.3 (row 2) and t8ej.1 (639dc1d c, d). Code already rejects these; tests are missing. VTC: VTCParticipant/set create and update setting e2eeFingerprint -> invalidProperties; update setting plain gatewayData -> invalidProperties; VTCCall/set update setting joinUri -> invalidProperties (extend the loop at vtc-server tests/call_state.rs ~L296). Chat: Space/set create and update each sending roles, members, categories, uncategorizedChannelIds as plain properties -> invalidProperties, nothing stored; ChatContact/set update with endpoints -> invalidProperties, contact unchanged; optionally Chat/set slowModeSeconds, permissionOverrides, categoryId, position (same list, untested). Oracle: the drafts' '(server-set)'/'(immutable)' field attributes (639dc1d). Test-only; a failing test means a real bug: fix the code.
